sources.title: Reproducible separate-chaining, open-addressing and rehashing model tests

claims.text: The model test shows two distinct keys with the same initial bucket remain separately retrievable under separate chaining, supporting the candidate's distinction between hash-based location and key equality confirmation.
The model test shows an occupied key after a deleted colliding key remains findable only when deletion leaves a tombstone instead of a terminating empty slot.

The model test reinserts every live entry into a differently sized table, counts one reinsert per live entry, and verifies every mapping remains present, supporting the candidate's rehashing explanation.

The model test counts three key comparisons to find the third key in one collision bucket. The candidate limits this to a model-derived collision-work boundary and does not claim a library-specific average or worst-case complexity.

unsupported_claims: 开放寻址探测方法与其语义未逐项映射。
装载因子/性能外推和链接法选型结论未逐项映射。
hash 稳定性、相等关系及抽象并发边界未由现有模型测试覆盖。
findings: 候选覆盖来源问法但材料性事实证据不足，达到两轮上限。
